assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: corrected eight-angle photographic concept reference sheet for planning automotive animation.
Input image 1 is the STRICT VEHICLE IDENTITY. Input image 2 is ONLY a layout and typography reference; replace every silver modern vehicle in it with the older dark vehicle from image 1.
The strict identity is the BLACK / very dark navy OLDER BOXY Jeep Cherokee in input image 1, with the Liberty KK-style upright squared body. Closely copy its actual body proportions: tall squared passenger cabin, nearly flat roof with factory rails, upright windshield and tailgate, boxy fenders, vertical rectangular headlight clusters with softly rounded lower corners, bright chrome upright seven-slot grille, modest stock bumper, silver stock five-spoke alloy wheels like the photograph, normal tires and factory ride height, dark tinted windows. The vehicle remains deep black/dark navy in every view, with only natural reflections. It is NOT the silver rounded modern KL Cherokee appearing in the other input; do not use the KL body, slim horizontal lamps, modern grille/fascia, or any newer generation. Do not add a lift kit, off-road accessories, huge wheels, sporty bodykit, spare tire on the tailgate, or a modernized roofline.
Create exactly ONE wide 16:9 PNG board, approximately 2560x1440. Maintain the layout in input image 2: simple navy heading "Jeep Cherokee", a clean 4-column x 2-row arrangement of exactly eight full-vehicle studio photographs, small navy Spanish view labels below each. White seamless background, subtle tire contact shadows, gentle warm side key light with cool fill. No scene, skyline, checkerboard, cards, borders, UI, prices, decorative logos or new text.
Exact eight distinct views and labels in reading order:
Top row 1: straight front, "Frente".
Top row 2: front-left three-quarter, "Tres cuartos delantero izquierdo".
Top row 3: left side profile with nose pointing left, "Lateral izquierdo".
Top row 4: rear-left three-quarter, "Tres cuartos trasero izquierdo".
Bottom row 1: straight rear, "Atrás".
Bottom row 2: rear-right three-quarter, "Tres cuartos trasero derecho".
Bottom row 3: right side profile with nose pointing right, "Lateral derecho".
Bottom row 4: front-right three-quarter, "Tres cuartos delantero derecho".
All eight views must show exactly the SAME dark older boxy Cherokee with consistent paint, exact same silver five-spoke factory wheels, grille, vertical headlamps, taillamps, wheelbase, ride height, roof rails, trim and window geometry. Use equal camera height, focal length and physical scale, aligned tire baselines. Front/rear cars must not be disproportionately enlarged relative to profiles. The complete vehicle fits inside every cell. Differentiate left and right correctly; no repeated front views in rear cells. Do not duplicate the fuel filler door onto both sides: show only ONE fuel door on the vehicle's left rear quarter consistently, and none on the right. Match opposite-side structural asymmetries rather than mirroring details blindly. Unseen rear/opposite surfaces are conservative concept inferences, not verified real-unit photographs. No modern KL styling anywhere.

Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: full-color automotive foreground cutout for a cinematic dealership showroom.
Input image 1 is the STRICT VEHICLE IDENTITY. Input image 2 is ONLY pose, framing and sunset-light reference, not vehicle identity.
The strict identity is the BLACK / very dark navy OLDER BOXY Jeep Cherokee in input image 1, with the Liberty KK-style upright squared body. Closely copy its actual body proportions: tall squared passenger cabin, nearly flat roof with factory rails, upright windshield and tailgate, boxy fenders, vertical rectangular headlight clusters with softly rounded lower corners, bright chrome upright seven-slot grille, modest stock bumper, silver stock five-spoke alloy wheels like the photograph, normal tires and factory ride height, dark tinted windows. The vehicle remains deep black/dark navy in every view, with only natural reflections. It is NOT the silver rounded modern KL Cherokee appearing in the other input; do not use the KL body, slim horizontal lamps, modern grille/fascia, or any newer generation. Do not add a lift kit, off-road accessories, huge wheels, sporty bodykit, spare tire on the tailgate, or a modernized roofline.
Create exactly ONE high-resolution full-color photorealistic isolated vehicle PNG with GENUINE transparent alpha background. Transparency means zero-alpha pixels around the vehicle, never a rendered checkerboard or opaque colored backdrop. The car itself must retain full original realistic color and detail; do not return a black/white silhouette.
Canvas: 1859x846 wide panorama. Front three-quarter view with nose toward image-left, same general camera/perspective as input image 2. Entire older black Cherokee, including all roof rails, bumpers, mirrors and tires, lies approximately inside bbox x450..1350, y300..760, with clean transparent margins. Top quarter and all outer edges stay empty. Do not crop any part of the vehicle. Identity and clean isolation are the highest priorities.
Lighting: polished realistic automotive photography. Gentle warm sunset highlights from image-right along the roof, windows and dark glossy paint; cool blue environmental fill on the left, matching input image 2. Keep paint truly deep black/dark navy, never turn the vehicle silver. Reflections may be visible only ON the car. Maintain true stock silver five-spoke wheels and chrome grille from the identity image.
Remove all background, ground, pavement, water, bridge, trees and sky. No contact shadow, ground shadow, reflected floor, detached gray area or checkerboard outside the car: shadows will be added separately on the website. Clean carefully antialiased edges around the exact entire car. No new text, watermark or standalone logos; only ordinary vehicle emblems naturally attached to the car.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: targeted defect repair to an existing full-color automotive cutout source.
Input image is the exact EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the interior pixels of the front windshield glass. The current windshield incorrectly shows a gray/blue checkerboard grid through the left upper/central glass and behind the cabin; erase every checkerboard square within the windshield. Replace ONLY those windshield glass regions with believable continuous dark blue-black tinted automotive glass, a subtle cool blue sky reflection, realistic dark cabin seats/dashboard behind the glass, matching the existing remaining windshield.
Keep the windshield's exact outline, frame, pillars, glass shape, wipers, highlights and surrounding body pixels unchanged. No checkerboard pattern, plaid, regular grid, mesh or geometric squares may remain inside the windshield. Avoid unnatural solid flat fill; it must look like real tinted glass in the same cinematic sunset photograph.
PIXEL-ALIGNMENT INVARIANTS: keep exact 1859×846 full canvas, existing entire vehicle size, every car edge, pose, framing, position, wheel geometry, mirrors, roof rails, antenna, black/dark-navy paint, chrome grille, vertical headlamps, existing sunset reflections on side windows, all body details and lighting unchanged. Keep the original checkerboard BACKGROUND OUTSIDE the car completely unchanged; it will be removed separately with an aligned mask. Do not resize, crop, move, tilt, restyle, improve or regenerate any other part of the image. Do not add/remove text or emblems. Output exactly one repaired full-color PNG image.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: technical grayscale isolation matte, aligned exactly to the provided full-color Jeep Cherokee source.
Convert the input to ONE flat white-vehicle/black-background mask without changing its exact 1859×846 canvas or the vehicle's position, scale, framing or silhouette. This is a technical mask, not a new vehicle photograph.
Fill every pixel INSIDE the exact existing vehicle's silhouette PURE WHITE RGB(255,255,255), including all dark glass and windshield (even where the source shows checkerboard THROUGH glass), black paint, mirrors, roof rails, antenna, headlights, grille openings, wheels/tires, bumpers, underbody, license plate and every attached vehicle part. The entire car is one uniform featureless solid-white shape; no internal detail, outlines, holes, reflections, shadows, texture, patterns, gray tones or retained black regions.
Fill every pixel OUTSIDE the exact vehicle silhouette PURE BLACK RGB(0,0,0), including all checkerboard background, gaps beneath the chassis, gaps between tires, and actual open gaps above the roof beneath the roof-rail bars. The black-and-white mask should distinguish physical openings from glass: glass stays white; genuinely open holes remain black.
Preserve the exact fine outer contour of the source, including the thin antenna and roof rails, tire curves, mirrors and bumper. Minimal clean antialiasing only at the contour boundary. No enlarged halo, ground shadow, reflection, floating shape, checkerboard, framing margins, crop, scaling, movement or camera change. This mask must overlay the input image in the same original pixel coordinates. Output one 1859×846 opaque PNG image with a featureless white car and flat black exterior, no text.
